reason: r6 prototype candidate: adds one cGUIObjScissorMask above the sharpness bar of the gauge row, sized from the bar's own drawing area so the fill is current points over maximum points, and cycles the clip through 0, 25, 50 and 100 percent for 20 seconds each. Tier colours, tier frames, effects, atlases and vertex colours are untouched, and no game archive is edited. Not approved for distribution; r6 runtime NOT RUN; r5 was run on Eden, sampled correctly, and reported stage 20 without inserting.
